name: Vicious Study (Ex)
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents

Benefit(s): A slayer that selects this talent doubles the critical threat range of any weapon attacks that he makes against a studied target. This ability doesn’t stack with other, similar effects, such as the keen special weapon ability or the Improved Critical feat.
